$comment: Accepted dependency-audit findings. Every entry here is a high or critical
advisory in a PRODUCTION dependency that CI would otherwise block on
An exception is a decision with a name and a date on it, not a `|| true`.
scripts/check-audit-exceptions.mjs fails the build when an entry is past
its expiry, when it has no owner, or when pnpm is ignoring a GHSA that is
not listed here — so an exception rots loudly instead of quietly.
To accept a finding: add it here AND to pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreGhsas in
package.json, with the shortest expiry you can defend.

exceptions.title: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
reason: Reached only by the Prisma CLI's own configuration merge, which runs at
build and migration time over files in this repository. No request path
reaches it: the generated client does not import deepmerge-ts, and
The fix is deepmerge-ts >= 8.0.0, a major bump inside Prisma's
dependency tree. Forcing it with a pnpm override during a launch window
risks breaking migrations and client generation to close a finding that
no customer request can reach. Take it with the next Prisma upgrade.
